public_notebook.source_capture: Current public source response whose metadata reported currentVersionNumber=8; an explicit version-8 GetKernel request returned HTTP 403.
public_notebook.execution_evidence: Public logs contain notebook conversion messages only; no training stdout, metric, checkpoint, or retained output is exposed.

attached_data.file_identity_semantics: Kaggle exposed object ETags represented as MD5 values. These are recorded storage identities and are not represented as SHA-256 digests.

preprocessed_corpus_description.evidence_role: Public attached-dataset description; the training notebook consumes these arrays but does not construct them.
preprocessed_corpus_description.missing_slots: Zero-filled and represented in the mask.

training_data_pipeline.mask_semantics: The mask defines the valid-range endpoints. Neighbor validity is not checked independently when constructing a three-slice window.
training_data_pipeline.short_study_fallback: Use the source fallback when fewer than three centers remain; the source does not expose a frozen output fixture for this branch.
training_data_pipeline.training_center_selection: Build the valid center pool, random.shuffle it for each __getitem__, and take k centers.
training_data_pipeline.evaluation_center_selection: Select k_eval evenly spaced centers with linspace.
training_data_pipeline.scale: Convert uint8 to float and divide by 255.
training_data_pipeline.resize: Bilinear resize to the configured model resolution.

labels.missing_file_behavior: Print an explanatory message and exit successfully without training.

gold_validation.selection: Rows where all twelve target columns are non-null.

labels.training_targets: Continuous report-derived soft probabilities for non-gold studies; values are not thresholded.
labels.unknown_semantics: No unknown class, ignore index, partial-label mask, or explicit range validation.
labels.positive_weight: Compute training-label means, clip prevalence to [0.03,0.7], compute (1-prev)/prev, then clip each weight to [1,10].

candidate.reason: The training notebook neither attaches nor pins this dataset and only searches for the required basename.

configurations.discrepancy: The source does not identify which configuration produced a public checkpoint or completed run.

model.backbone_factory: timm.create_model(arch,pretrained=use_timm,num_classes=0,in_chans=3); ViT-like names additionally use global_pool=token and dynamic_img_size=true, other architectures use global_pool=avg.
model.checkpoint_initialization: timm selects pretrained weights; none or empty selects random initialization; a path loads only backbone.* keys with strict=false and unwraps a student mapping when present.
model.head: LayerNorm(F); Linear(F,256), Tanh, Dropout(0.2), Linear(256,12); per-target softmax attention over windows; per-target clsW dot pooled feature plus clsb.
model.classifier_initialization: clsW zeros followed by trunc_normal std=0.02; clsb zeros; Linear and LayerNorm modules otherwise use PyTorch defaults.
model.freeze_blocks: When positive, freeze matching leading blocks.N or stages.N groups; only trainable parameters enter the optimizer.

optimization.loss: BCEWithLogitsLoss with per-target pos_weight and continuous soft targets.
optimization.optimizer: AdamW with separate trainable backbone and head parameter groups.
optimization.optimizer_defaults: AdamW beta, epsilon, and other unspecified values use the installed PyTorch defaults.
optimization.scheduler: OneCycleLR with max_lr=[backbone_lr,head_lr], total_steps=len(train_loader)*epochs, pct_start=0.15; step once per batch.

precision_and_seed.autocast: CUDA training and evaluation use torch.autocast with bfloat16; CPU does not use that branch.

checkpointing.validation_metric: Macro mean of twelve per-target ROC-AUC values on the 58 all-known gold studies.
checkpointing.best_selection: Strictly greater gold macro ROC-AUC replaces the best epoch.
checkpointing.topk_averaging: Retain the top epochs in RAM; equally average floating tensors and copy non-floating tensors from the highest-ranked state; write an _swa.pt file.
checkpointing.swa_semantics: Snapshot tensor averaging only; no torch.optim.swa_utils, SWA scheduler, or online SWA update.
checkpointing.post_average_state: Evaluate the averaged state on gold, then restore the best single-epoch model in memory.

source_resource_comments.typical_peak_memory: 23.7 GB for the documented CoAtNet arm
source_resource_comments.topk_copy_memory: approximately 293 MB per CoAtNet copy and approximately 87 MB per small-ViT copy
source_resource_comments.evidence_role: Source comments only; not measured Kaggle T4 feasibility evidence.

evidence_semantics.published_authoritative: Directly observed public notebook code, metadata, attached-input identities, released checkpoint metadata, or verified Phase 1 evidence.
evidence_semantics.best_evidence_inferred: Selected reconstruction input or configuration supported by multiple public signals but not proven to be the author historical run identity.
evidence_semantics.reconstruction_specific_pinned_identity: Identity measured from an asset, environment, manifest, or checkpoint used by this reconstruction; it makes no claim about the author historical run.
